title: EventFeed

event.description: Serialized event object maximum is 16 KiB measured in UTF-8 bytes.

events.description: Events are in ascending feedPosition order. A batch contains at most 100 events. Never truncate or silently omit an oversized event.

description: The serialized response is limited to 2 MiB measured in UTF-8 bytes. An empty feed returns events: [] and hasMore: false.
